caption: Before install, Shopify lists what the app may read: device and activity data of customers, the store owner's staff data, and customers, products, orders and discounts.
Live after one click on Publish: the preview drawer shows a checkout timer at 09:54, a rewards bar at All Rewards unlocked and two discount codes stacked to $110 off; the store avatar is hidden.
On a development store every feature is free. For live stores the Free plan stops at 30 orders a month; the store name is hidden.
Above 30 orders the price follows order volume: nine tiers from $8.99 a month (99 orders) to $198.99 (10,000+), each with a 14 day trial; the store name is hidden.
Shopify sets the spending limit for Essential 1 at $198.99 per 30 days, the price of the top tier, because the app bills on usage. We did not approve; the store name is hidden.
The app's own FAQ: uninstalling cancels the subscription and removes the drawer from the storefront straight away; the store name and a reviewer's name are hidden.
Cancelling is done on the same Plans page and takes effect at once; the drawer is unpublished but the settings stay for a later return.
